ret = panel.pct_change()
print("panel range:", panel.index.min().date(), "->", panel.index.max().date(), "shape", panel.shape)

for name, col in [("SPX", "SPX"), ("HSI", "HSI"), ("000300.SH", "000300.SH"), ("BTC", "BTC"), ("XAU","XAU"), ("NDX","NDX")]:
    c = panel[col].dropna()
    if len(c) < 130: 
        print(name, "insufficient"); continue
    ma20 = c.rolling(20).mean().iloc[-1]; ma60 = c.rolling(60).mean().iloc[-1]; ma120 = c.rolling(120).mean().iloc[-1]
    last = c.iloc[-1]
    slope60 = (ma60 - c.rolling(60).mean().shift(20).iloc[-1]) / c.rolling(60).mean().shift(20).iloc[-1] * 100
    dd = last / c.rolling(252).max().iloc[-1] - 1
    vol20 = ret[col].dropna().tail(20).std() * np.sqrt(252) * 100
    print(f"{name:<10} last={last:>10.1f}  MA20/60/120={ma20:>10.1f}/{ma60:>10.1f}/{ma120:>10.1f}  slope60={slope60:+.2f}%  dd252={dd*100:+.1f}%  vol20={vol20:.1f}%")

# Cross-asset mean pairwise correlation (60d)
c60 = ret.tail(60).corr()
vals = c60.values[np.triu_indices_from(c60.values, k=1)]
print(f"\nmean pairwise corr (60d, 15 assets): {np.nanmean(vals):.3f}")

# VIX level & trend
vp = Path(ID / "VIX.csv")
if vp.exists():
    vix = pd.read_csv(vp, parse_dates=["date"]).set_index("date").sort_index()
    vix = vix[vix.index <= pd.Timestamp("2026-07-29")]
    v = vix["close"].dropna()
    print(f"VIX last={v.iloc[-1]:.1f}  20d mean={v.tail(20).mean():.1f}  60d mean={v.tail(60).mean():.1f}  1m chg={v.iloc[-1]/v.iloc[-21]-1:+.2%}" if len(v)>21 else "VIX insufficient")

# 20d momentum of the equal-weight 15-asset basket
b = panel.mean(axis=1)
print(f"basket 20d mom={b.iloc[-1]/b.iloc[-21]-1:+.2%}  60d mom={b.iloc[-1]/b.iloc[-61]-1:+.2%}" if len(b)>61 else "basket insufficient")
